# Scene-first invention · S09

Editable ordered moments distinguish actor, trigger, known/unknown information, available actions and stakes. Drag moments to reorder or use Reorder; drag interventions into a moment or use Move. Walk selects a moment. Develop captures action, assumption and rehearsal/test. Editing/reordering the scene or relocating an intervention flags fit for review without erasing reasoning. Removing a moment keeps its ideas unplaced.

My work duplicates a scene for variations without changing the original. Local persistence, grouped Undo, recovery/cross-tab pause and Markdown/JSON export/import use the creative-kit. Limits: 8 moments, 24 interventions, 100 workspaces; fictional examples and user hypotheses, no generated verdicts. Tests cover preservation, changed-context checks and import integrity. Parent verifies actual browser interactions.
